channel.title: AI GridWatch — Virginia data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Virginia, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Franklin County: data center moratorium — Enacted
Virginia (tax/zoning): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: State-level restrictions on data center tax incentives and new zoning requirements

item.title: Loudoun County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Board of Supervisors voted 6-1 to direct staff to prepare moratorium options by Sep 15. Legal questions remain about Virginia law's allowance of blanket moratoriums. World's largest data center hub (~46M sq ft constructed or permitted)

item.title: Chesapeake: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 8-month pause on data center applications. Council had previously rejected a 350,000 sq ft project in Jun 2025. Planning commission drafting zoning amendments for case-by-case review

item.title: Front Royal: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 90-day moratorium on land-use applications for data centers, 6-0. Planning Commission drafting language to prohibit data centers in every town zoning district

item.title: Suffolk: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Council directed Planning Commission to draft UDO amendment prohibiting data centers in all zoning districts. Applications not being considered during drafting, but formal enactment pending
